services.name: Seal and Lighthouse Cruise - Beth Ann
services.desc: About Vacations are made even more special when you get the opportunity to take a life changing step with your loved ones or celebrate a special occasion. Whether it be asking that someone special to spend the rest of your lives together, taking that next step and making the answer to that question official with a small ceremony, or celebrating an anniversary or birthday, there really is no better place to do it than on the water with your favorite town of Provincetown providing the perfect backdrop. Bring your beverages of choice, and some snacks, or if you desire we can arrange to have a bottle or two of fine wine or champagne and some fabulous appetizers delivered for you. Rates Private

services.name: Provincetown Evening Cruise - Beth Ann
services.desc: About After the hustle and bustle from a day at the beach, and before your evening dinner reservation, come aboard the Beth Ann for a two hour relaxing excursion through Provincetown harbor, and around the historic and iconic lighthouses at Long Pt., Wood End and Race Pt. Bask in the comfort only Beth Ann can offer, as you experience the brilliant reflection of the suns early evening glow on the water. Bring your beverages of choice, and some snacks, or if you desire we can arrange to have a bottle or two of fine wine or champagne and some fabulous appetizers delivered for you. Fun in the Sun - Beth Ann
services.desc: About Normally our customers want to go to the beach of their choice, where we anchor the boat relatively close to shore. Some like privacy, which inner Provincetown Harbor, Long Pt., Hatches Harbor and the great stretches of the ocean beaches past Race Point offer. Others like a little more action, such as between Herring Cove and Wood End, where bathing suits at times become optional and more of a party atmosphere prevails. Wherever we go, the Beth Ann becomes your home base. Wade or swim into shore and set up on the beach. Dive into the water to cool yourself off and relax on the boat. services.name: Striped Bass and Bluefish - Beth Ann
services.desc: Rates Starting at Half Day Private Charter: $699.60 for 4, Additional cost for 5th & 6th person Duration Half Day Private Charter: 4 Hours About The Beth Ann has a full line of light and medium weight spinning rods and van stahl reels, spooled with power pro braided line. We use these when vertical jigging using Daddy Mac jigs, RonZ plastics or a number of other fish-enticing lures. When we see the bass and blues breaking the surface we will also use these outfits to cast a variety of surface plugs and poppers. services.name: Sunset Whale Watch - Beth Ann
services.desc: Rates Private Charter - $885.10 for up to 4 people Additional People: - Additional fee per person for up to 2 more people Duration Trip Time: 4 Hours About Combine Cape Cods best private whale watch with a sunset evening cruise, two trips in one. We will travel and see the whales, and then experience a beautiful sunset within Provincetown Harbor. Stellwagen Bank, the National Marine Sanctuary located just north of Provincetown, is home to a myriad of marine life, most notably whales. We will see Humpbacks, Finbacks, and probably even Minke’s.
